_comment: The Claude Code adapter is rendered per-domain, not pasted. Current projections are path-instantiated (the domain's framework_root is baked into the command) and definition-hash-bound, so any static copy of a hooks block is born stale by construction — including every prior version of this file. Through this repository's manual CLI launch route, run: mdllm adapter-install <domain> --harness claude --dry-run (review the owned diff), then the same command without --dry-run to apply. Inspect state at any time with mdllm doctor <domain> --harness claude. Here mdllm is route-neutral notation, not an installed executable.
_history: Until 2026-08-18 this file carried a pasteable two-handler SessionStart block whose commentary asserted estate-sync-before-session-start ordering. Live Claude Code disproved that premise at Gate 5R.0 — matching handlers run in parallel — and that exact form survives only as recognised-legacy migration data (legacy-v1) inside the adapter, refreshable through adapter-install --refresh-legacy after a reviewed diff. The block is deliberately not reproduced here: an example that looks pasteable gets pasted.
_scope: Claude Code lifecycle evidence and VS Code Copilot compatibility are separate claims (plan Phase 6). The rendered settings are Claude Code evidence only; Copilot reads .claude/settings.json but remains separately untested.
